attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives neither man a year: it sets them only «κατά τους χρόνους της βασιλείας του Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.)», so there is no `dates` object. Two names in one line, so two folders; the other Christians who contended with them are not named and are not numbered, and the crowd who confessed at the wonder are not either, so neither has a folder. The corpus holds nobody else of this name. The page prints no hymn.
